name: Does This Text Mention the Deadline
description: A containment check returning a boolean — the branch condition for a workflow that routes on what a document says.

data.comment:
# Does This Text Mention the Deadline

Checks whether a piece of text contains a word and returns true or false. Use it as the condition for a branch that routes on what a document says.

**How it works:** "Text" holds a sample sentence about submissions closing. The Code node "Contains 'close'" searches it for the substring and returns a boolean, which "Boolean" displays. It runs locally with no model or key.

**Try this:** Edit the "Text" value so it no longer mentions closing, run it again, and confirm the result flips to false.

data.value: Submissions close on the 14th; late entries are not reviewed.
